_comment: Reference values for rdkit-script-debug (RDKit 2024.9.5, parse+Cleanup+canonical SMILES+MolWt pipeline over input.smi). Deterministic; calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: Verifier re-runs the agent's fixed script (exit 0, regenerates outputs) and independently replays parse->Cleanup->canonical/MW from the pinned input; counts exact, mw_mean 1e-4. 5 oracle runs identical (spread 0).
